These commands are available three ways — in the FREE-WILi GUI app, in a serial
terminal, and on the device itself. See
[Connecting it to a computer](../start-here/connecting.md) for how to reach them.

> **Note:** These settings live on the display CPU but are stored and saved by the main processor. They cover the display backlight, screen timeout and wake triggers - power-zone switching itself is in the Power Management panel.

## Brightness Powered

Display backlight percent while on USB power

**How to use it** — press `a`.

**What you enter** — `value`.

## Brightness Batt Gt 70

Display backlight percent with battery above 70 percent

**How to use it** — press `b`.

**What you enter** — `value`.

## Brightness Batt Gt 30

Display backlight percent with battery between 30 and 70 percent

**How to use it** — press `c`.

**What you enter** — `value`.

## Brightness Batt Lt 30

Display backlight percent with battery below 30 percent

**How to use it** — press `g`.

**What you enter** — `value`.

## Battery Timeout

Seconds of inactivity before the display shuts off on battery

**How to use it** — press `e`.

**What you enter** — `value`.

## Powered Timeout

Seconds of inactivity before the display shuts off on USB power, 0 keeps it on

**How to use it** — press `f`.

**What you enter** — `value`.

## Wake On Sound

Wake the display when the mic hears a sound

**How to use it** — press `s`.

## Wake On Move

Wake the display when the accelerometer sees movement

**How to use it** — press `m`.

## Auto Power Zones

Auto-manage power zones; off keeps every live rail on, commands still raise rails on demand

**How to use it** — press `o`.
